purpose: Dated 2004 offseason facts: draft, moratorium, cap publication, exceptions, minimum and rookie scales, 2004-05 opening day and the 30-team alignment. A cap figure is live only from its publication date.

finals_2004.value: Detroit beat the Los Angeles Lakers 4-1; series June 6-15, 2004; last game (Game 5) June 15, 2004

free_agency_negotiation_opens.note: Free agents become free July 1; teams may negotiate and agree to terms but not sign (except required tenders, qualifying offers, first-round scale signings and second-round minimum signings) during the moratorium.

salary_cap_2004_05.announced: 2004-07-13 (Tuesday night, NBA announcement on the eve of moratorium end)
salary_cap_2004_05.effective: 2004-07-14 (cap adjusts on the first day after the moratorium)

luxury_tax_threshold_2004_05.note: ESPN/SportsTicker gives '$54.6 million'; the exact $54,630,000 figure is widely cited (Spotrac) but not confirmed in a contemporaneous source retrieved here. The tax ultimately was not triggered for 2004-05 (salaries+benefits 60.4% vs 63.333% trigger) -- that outcome is hindsight and must not be used before the 2004-05 season ends.

one_million_exception_2004_05.note: cannot be used two seasons in a row

minimum_salary_scale_2004_05.note: Expansion club (Charlotte) minimums are 3/4 of these for its first two seasons.

value.note: source prints year-1 as '$2.075,300' (typo); read as $2,075,300

rookie_scale_2004_first_round.note: Scale amounts for players drafted in 2004 (1999 CBA, 98-99 figure +5% simple per year). Actual contracts may be 80%-120% of scale; most sign at 120%. Year-4 is a team option to be exercised by October 31 after the second season; the percentage columns are required raises.

cba_term_note.value: The 1999 CBA ran through the 2004-05 season (league declined/extension issues aside); 2004-05 figures above are under the 1999 CBA.

alignment_2004_05.note: Listed alphabetically; the source page orders by final 2004-05 standings (hindsight), which was deliberately not carried over. Date the realignment was announced: unverified.

playoff_format_change.note: Division-winner top-3 seeding from 2004-05 not researched here.

sources.use: 2004 draft pick order, drafting club, bbr_id, college (retrieved 2026-10-05)
draft date/location, lottery date and top-3 result, positions, schools, pick provenance and draft-day trades (with its cited NBA.com/ESPN/AP/USA Today references)
expansion draft date, 19 selections, previous clubs, RFA markers, linked deals
AP, June 22, 2004: expansion draft report (19 picks, 9 RFAs, Jahidi White deal, Pavlovic to Cleveland)
Larry Coon's NBA Salary Cap FAQ, final 1999-CBA version (11/16/05): moratorium dates, cap table, minimum salaries, exceptions, expansion rules
Larry Coon, 1999-CBA rookie scale tables incl. 2004-05
SportsTicker via ESPN, July 13, 2004: 2004-05 cap, tax, floor, Charlotte cap, MLE, $1M exception, rookie minimum; moratorium ends July 14

notes: HINDSIGHT WARNING: the ESPN cap story (July 13, 2004) mentions a reported Shaquille O'Neal trade to Miami. That is a real Miami transaction and, per AGENTS.md, must not be applied or leaked into the simulation. Only the cap figures from that article were taken.
HINDSIGHT WARNING: tax-not-triggered for 2004-05 and BRI/escrow outcomes in the cbafaq FAQ are season results; do not use before they would be known.
Several Wikipedia source rows include later-career honors (All-Star, ROY, etc.); these were deliberately omitted.

Draft-night rights moves: 5 WAS->DAL, 7 PHO->CHI, 20 DEN->ORL, 21 UTA->DAL, 22 NJN->POR, 31 CHI->PHO, 35 SEA->MEM, 36 ORL->MEM, 39 TOR->MIA, 42 ATL->SAS, 47 MIA->TOR, 50 DAL->HOU, 55 HOU->DAL. For 35 and 36 the only cited source is an AP item dated July 7, 2004 stating the deals were on draft day.
Pre-draft trades of the No. 2 (June 21) and No. 45 (June 23) picks mean Charlotte itself made both selections; BBR and Wikipedia agree.

Pick 42 provenance: Wikipedia footnote says Orlando sent it to Atlanta for Anthony Johnson on Feb 24, 2000, which precedes Orlando's Dec 2003 acquisition; the chain is internally inconsistent and the ORL->ATL date is unverified.
Pick 17 provenance: the DET->ATL leg is from the Feb 2004 Rasheed Wallace three-team deal; Wikipedia's footnote dates its announcement Feb 19, 2004.
Picks 1-29 positions and schools are from Wikipedia; BBR does not list positions on its draft page.
Rookie scale pick 6 year-1 printed as '$2.075,300' at the source; recorded as 2,075,300.
All bbr_ids are as linked from basketball-reference.com's 2004 draft and 2004 expansion draft pages; none were guessed. BBR's draft page also links ids for picks who never played in the NBA.
web.archive.org was unreachable from this environment, so archived NBA.com press releases (expansion selection order, lottery release) could not be read directly.
